description.value: Best Western Plus Prince George sits at the junction of Highways 16 (Yellowhead) and 97, making it one of the most strategically placed hotels for touring cyclists crossing northern British Columbia. The property markets itself as the gateway to BC's Northern Capital, with the hotel overview highlighting its role as a launchpad for exploring Prince George's natural and cultural attractions. As a Plus-tier franchise, it offers a higher amenity standard than base Best Western properties.

address.value: 3387 Highway 16 W, Prince George, BC V2N 5P8
